couplets.en: Let someone be a son of Mary.

lines: Mere dukh ki dawa kare koi
couplets.en: Let someone bring a remedy for my sorrow.

lines: Na suno gar bura kahe koi
couplets.en: Turn a deaf ear when someone speaks ill.

lines: Na kaho gar bura kare koi
couplets.en: Say nothing when someone wrongs you.
Let someone be a son of Mary.

lines: Baat par waan zabaan katti hai
couplets.en: There, a word can cost you your tongue.

lines: Woh kahen aur suna kare koi
couplets.en: Let them speak, and let someone listen.
Let someone be a son of Mary.

lines: Kaun hai jo nahin hai haajatmand
couplets.en: Who among us is free of need?

lines: Kis ki haajat rawa kare koi
couplets.en: Whose need is anyone to answer?
Let someone be a son of Mary.

lines: Jab tawaqqo hi uth gayi Ghalib
couplets.en: When hope itself has gone, Ghalib.

lines: Kyun kisi ka gila kare koi
couplets.en: Why hold a grievance against anyone?
Let someone be a son of Mary.
